scenario: A hospital administrator must assign exactly seven interns—Ferreira, Gupta, Hollis, Ito, Jain, Kwon, and Lowe—to exactly one of three departments: Cardiology, Dermatology, and Emergency. Cardiology will be assigned exactly three interns, Dermatology will be assigned exactly two interns, and Emergency will be assigned exactly two interns. The assignment must meet the following conditions: Ferreira and Gupta are assigned to the same department. Hollis and Ito are assigned to different departments. Jain is assigned to Cardiology. If Kwon is assigned to Dermatology, then Lowe is assigned to Emergency. Exactly one of Hollis and Kwon is assigned to Cardiology.

explanations.correct: Jain is in Cardiology; exactly one of Hollis/Kwon (here Hollis — wait, both listed). Re-examine: Cardiology = Jain, Kwon, Hollis — this has BOTH. Actually the rule says exactly one of Hollis and Kwon in Cardiology. Let me pick correct. Reviewing choices against solution {Ferreira:2, Gupta:2, Hollis:1, Ito:3, Jain:1, Kwon:1, Lowe:3}: Cardiology=Hollis,Jain,Kwon; Dermatology=Ferreira,Gupta; Emergency=Ito,Lowe. That matches no listed choice exactly. Matching solution {Ferreira:1,Gupta:1,Hollis:1,Ito:3,Jain:1,Kwon:2,Lowe:3}: Cardiology=Ferreira,Gupta,Hollis,Jain — too many. Use {Ferreira:2,Gupta:2,Hollis:3,Ito:2,Jain:1,Kwon:1,Lowe:3}: Cardiology=Jain,Kwon; Dermatology=Ferreira,Gupta,Ito; too many in Derm. The correct choice E (Cardiology: Jain, Kwon, Hollis; Dermatology: Ferreira, Gupta; Emergency: Ito, Lowe) violates exactly_one_of. Therefore none of those works — the correct answer must be the one matching a verified solution. Choice A: Cardiology=Ferreira,Gupta,Jain; Derm=Hollis,Kwon; Emergency=Ito,Lowe. Jain in Cardiology ✓; Ferreira=Gupta ✓; Hollis(2)≠Ito(3) ✓; exactly one of Hollis/Kwon in Cardiology: neither — violates. So A fails. Recheck verified solution 5: {Ferreira:1,Gupta:1,Hollis:1,Ito:2,Jain:1,Kwon:3,Lowe:2}: Cardiology has 4 interns — wait, that's Ferreira,Gupta,Hollis,Jain = 4, violating group size 3. That solution is invalid; the verified set was wrong.

explanations.E: Jain is in Cardiology; Ferreira and Gupta are together in Dermatology; Hollis (Cardiology) and Ito (Emergency) are in different departments; exactly one of Hollis and Kwon (both in Cardiology here) — violates. This answer set needs regeneration.
